{{Top|ga|audio=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LajcVNxsgsw}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Cthallops-SC-LearnAboutPirates.jpg]] |name=Cthallops |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Cthallops' species]]{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Green]] |skin=Green |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|This is Cthallops.''"
"''He said he'd help us if we entertained him.|Fern and Wim|audio=Wim-Cthallops-SC5.flac|}} '''Cthallops''' was an [[Cthallops' species|alien]] patron of the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]] who encountered the [[Youngling|children]] [[Fern]], [[Neel]], [[Wim]], and [[KB]] along with the [[pirate]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] and the [[droid]] [[SM-33]] while they [[Mission to At Attin|searched]] for the [[Captain Rennod's Lair|lair]] of pirate [[Captain]] [[Tak Rennod]] around [[9 ABY]]. Although he initially thought Fern might be an [[assassin]], Cthallops agreed to aid their search in exchange for entertainment, listening to Wim tell a story of the [[Skeleton Crew|group's]] recent adventures on the planet [[At Achrann]]. He then smashed a hole in part of the [[spa]]'s floor so the children and their allies could proceed to the lair. ==Biography== {{Quote|You there, attendant. I am in need of refreshments.''"
"''Yes. My apologies, I'll just go get you a selection of our finest—''"
"''You don't smell like an attendant. Are you an assassin?|Cthallops and Fern|audio=Cthallops-Fern-SC5.flac|}} [[File:Cthallops-Tentacle-SC5.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Extending from his seat in a spa pool, Cthallop's tentacle slams down infront of Fern in the Skull Ridge Mountain Spa.|Cthallops initially thought Fern might be an assassin but agreed to aid her and her friends in exchange for entertainment.]] Cthallops was an [[Cthallops' species|alien]] patron of the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]] during the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]] around [[9 ABY]].{{SkeletonCrewDate}} He was soaking alone in a bathing pool in one of the [[spa]]'s [[Cave|grottos]] when the [[Youngling|children]] [[Fern]] and [[Wim]] and their [[droid]] [[SM-33]] entered the cave in [[Mission to At Attin|search]] of the entrance to the [[Captain Rennod's Lair|secret lair]] of the legendary [[pirate]] [[Captain]] [[Tak Rennod]]. The trio was unaware of Cthallops until the patron called out to Fern, mistaking her{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{AD|Disney+}} for one of the spa's attendants. He requested refreshments, but as Fern nervously promised to fetch the patron a selection, Cthallops interrupted her, having realized she did not smell like the attendants. Slamming a [[Limb|tentacle]] down in front of Fern, the patron asked if the child was an [[assassin]], at which point SM-33 tried to confront Cthallops to defend his captain but was held back by a [[restraining bolt]]. Intrigued by the droid's use of the term "captain," Cthallops began speaking with Fern and Wim while the droid left to find their [[Skeleton Crew|allies]], the pirate [[Jod Na Nawood]] and the children [[Neel]] and [[KB]]. The alien agreed to aid the children in their search if they entertained him, and Wim told Cthallops of their recent adventure on the planet [[At Achrann]],{{SkeletonCrew|Can't Say I Remember No At Attin}} where they had been forcefully recruited into an [[Troik|army]] as child [[soldier]]s. Just as the story reached its climax, Nawood, SM-33, Neel, and KB arrived with spa security in pursuit. Wim introduced Cthallops, who he had told about Nawood, and the alien took a sniff of the pirate and warned the children not to trust him. [[File:Cthallops-FullCrew-SC5.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Emerging from a spa pool, Cthallops looms over Jod Na Nawood in the Skull Ridge Mountain Spa while the children of the Skeleton Crew and SM-33 watch.|Cthallops helped Fern and her friends enter Tak Rennod's secret lair.]] Nawood was unimpressed with the children's new friend until, at Fern's prompting, the alien slammed his spiked tentacle into a piece of the grotto's floor bearing Rennod's [[Captain Rennod's symbol|emblem]]. The [[stone]] floor shattered, revealing a hidden well leading down to the legendary pirate's lair. Cthallops then lowered the group into the well with his tentacle, warning them that he could smell guards approaching once they were all down. He then requested to one [[Standard day|day]] hear the end of the group's story if they survived. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|So this is Jod? ''[sniffs]'' You were right. Do not trust him.|Cthallops|audio=Cthallops-Jod-SC5.flac|}} Cthallops was a huge, [[Color|green]] [[alien]] with a monstrous, [[octopus]]-like face with protruding green [[eye]]s with vertical slits. He possessed several tentacles, one of which ended in a large, spiked club. He had a sense of smell capable of identifying different individuals and could tell the pirate Nawood was untrustworthy based on his smell. He enjoyed a good story{{Databank|cthallops|Cthallops}} and was willing to aid the children in exchange for entertainment, telling them that he would love to hear more of their story. ==Equipment== While in the spa, Cthallops wore a towel on his head. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:CthallopsPractical-VIP.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=On set, Neel sits in a rope pulley chair holding onto a blue tube that represents Cthallops after being lowered down from above. The rest of the Skeleton Crew stand looking at him in the tunnels of Lanupa, with the actor operating SM-33 visible behind the droid.|Cthallops tentacle was represented by a rope pulley on set.]] Cthallops was voiced by [[Patrick Seitz]] in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," the fifth episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 24]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}} Visual effects and animation studio [[Important Looking Pirates]]{{WebCite|url=https://www.ilpvfx.com/about|text=About|work=[https://www.ilpvfx.com/about Important Looking Pirates]|archivedate=20250407055048}} worked on the digital animation for Cthallops, including his complex tentacle animation, fleshy moustache, semi-rigid head spines, and luminous eyes.{{WebCite|url=https://www.ilpvfx.com/work/in-production:-skeleton-crew|text=Skeleton Crew|work=[https://www.ilpvfx.com/about Important Looking Pirates]|archivedate=20250307100012}} The character's movements were heavily restricted to better replicate the puppetry and animation used elsewhere in the show and to maintain the show's in-camera aesthetic. In the scene where Cthallops lowers the crew down into the well, his tentacle was represented on set by a seat for the actor being carried to sit on in a rope pulley system with a blue tube for them to hold on to. According to the series's showrunner [[Christopher Ford]], Cthallops and other elements on Lanupa were inspired by the film [[Wikipedia:Spirited Away|''Spirited Away'']].{{YouTube|video=h8Wd8ct2cP8|text=EXCLUSIVE Interview SKELETON CREW Showrunner and Writer Christopher Ford! | Resistance Broadcast|channel=@TRBpodcasts|name=TRB Podcasts|date=2025-01-23}} ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{ThisWeek|VLHkqJLIftk|Dispatch: Skull Ridge Mountain Looks Different}} *{{Databank|cthallops|Cthallops}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Cthallops|imagecat=Images of Cthallops}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=クタロプス |ka=კთალოპსი |tr=Cthallops }} [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
